slopeEstimator.definition: P_peak = maximum PENDING in drain.csv; t_peak = first timestamp reaching P_peak; t_zero = first timestamp reaching 0; slope = P_peak / ((t_zero - t_peak)/1000) rows/s; drain sampled every ~2s
slopeEstimator.linearityCheck: slope_half = (P_peak - P_at_mid) / ((t_mid - t_peak)/1000); |slope_half - slope| / slope > 30% requires disclosure
slopeEstimator.estimatorVarianceDisclosure: drain window contains only 6-12 samples at ~2s granularity; same-config spread today: A 89.3991/80.6171, B 66.9655/56.1843, C 121.9729/98.5905 - sampling-granularity noise is of the same order as the 1.5 threshold

verdict.reason: all 6 counting rounds valid (per-round M1/M4/M5/M6 passed; no M4/M6 red so no replacement round permitted), M3 ordering control passed (10.33% <= 20%), C-arm repeatability passed (21.20% <= 30%); BUT M2 effect gate FAILED on both ratios: slope(C1)/max(slope(A1),slope(B1)) = 121.9729/89.3991 = 1.3644 < 1.5 and slope(C2)/max(slope(A2),slope(B2)) = 98.5905/80.6171 = 1.2229 < 1.5; both ratios are > 1.0 so the reproof branch does not apply either; per the pre-registered three-branch rule the task lands in the UNDETERMINED branch: numbers reported as-is, no landing, no extrapolation, no conclusion of benefit or no-benefit
